headline: Bookkeeper
summary: Former retail store supervisor now working as a bookkeeper. After four years handling cash, inventory and customers at a department store branch, I trained in bookkeeping and Xero and have kept the books of three small businesses in Iriga for the past year. I want a full-time bookkeeping role with room to grow.

projects.name: Bookkeeping for a bakery chain
bullets: Set up a Xero file, bank feeds and a chart of accounts for a three-branch bakery.
Record daily sales, expenses and supplier bills, and send the owner a monthly profit summary.

projects.name: Invoicing for a water refilling business
projects.description: Replaced handwritten delivery slips with numbered invoices in Xero and a weekly Excel collection list.

skills: Retail cash handling and store operations

experience.title: Bookkeeper
bullets: Keep the books of three small businesses: a bakery chain, a water refilling station and a motorcycle parts shop.
Issue invoices and receipts and reconcile bank and e-wallet accounts every week.

experience.title: Retail Store Supervisor
bullets: Supervised 12 sales staff and the cash counters of a two-floor store.
Balanced daily cash and card sales and prepared deposit slips.
Ran monthly inventory counts and investigated stock variances with the warehouse.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Marketing
